items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well when I was in there the drummer with Claude Thornhill’s band -- damn, I can’t think of his name right now.

ctx.x: Because there’s still a segregated army if we’re talking about the early ‘40s, right.

On this side of the mountain, Straw Mountain was the black troops, on that side of the mountain was the white troops. Well when I was in there the drummer with Claude Thornhill’s band -- damn, I can’t think of his name right now.
I can’t think of his name either. Claude Thornhill, Jesus that’s -­
